record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a locally flat manifold (M, nabla), determine whether (M, nabla) admits a Hessian structure.

evidence.quote: Hessian structure in a locally ﬂat manifold (M, ∇)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth manifold equipped with a flat torsion-free affine connection $
abla$; that is, $(M,
abla)$ is a locally flat manifold, so that there exist local coordinate charts $\{x^1,\dots,x^n\}$ on $M$ in which the Christoffel symbols of $
abla$ vanish. A Riemannian metric $g$ on $M$ is called a Hessian metric (compatible with $
abla$) if, around every point of $M$, there exists a local affine coordinate system $\{x^1,\dots,x^n\}$ for $
abla$ and a smooth function $\varphi$ such that
$$g_{ij} =  rac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial x^i\,\partial x^j}.$$
The pair $(
abla,g)$ is then called a Hessian structure on $M$.

Problem: Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on a locally flat manifold $(M,
abla)$ for it to admit a Hessian structure, i.e., for the existence of a Riemannian metric $g$ which is Hessian with respect to $
abla$.
artifact.status_search_result: The existence problem for Hessian metrics on a given locally flat (affine) manifold is a long-standing question in Hessian/affine differential geometry going back to Shima. Available literature (Shima's monograph "The Geometry of Hessian Structures" and subsequent works including recent studies of the topology of low-dimensional Hessian manifolds) provides partial results, obstructions, and examples, but no general necessary and sufficient criterion appears to have been established. The problem is therefore considered open in general.

status_evidence.title: The topology of 3-dimensional Hessian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies which locally flat 3-manifolds carry Hessian metrics, indicating the existence question remains an active area.
status_evidence.claim: The general existence problem for Hessian metrics on locally flat manifolds is still under investigation, with partial results in low dimensions.

status_evidence.title: Geometry of Hessian Structures (Shima)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational treatment of Hessian structures on locally flat manifolds; provides examples and obstructions but no general existence criterion.
status_evidence.claim: No general necessary and sufficient condition for existence of a Hessian metric on a locally flat manifold is given.

status_evidence.title: Vanishing theorems for compact Hessian manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes obstructions (vanishing theorems) for compact Hessian manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Known results provide obstructions rather than a full characterization.
